name: Polynomial Constraint Camouflage
description: Replaces the explicit product constraint (c_u * c_v = 2) with a non-linear polynomial equation (p_u^3 + p_v^3 = 9) over the same domain {1,2}. This preserves the exact logical requirement (p_u != p_v) while breaking text-based pattern matching for bipartite graph coloring, forcing the model to algebraically deduce the mutual exclusion.
